query:
INSERT INTO report (source, external_id, title, url, published_at, raw)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
        ON CONFLICT (source, external_id) DO UPDATE SET
            title = EXCLUDED.title,
            url = EXCLUDED.url,
            published_at = EXCLUDED.published_at,
            raw = EXCLUDED.raw
        RETURNING id, (xmax = 0) AS "inserted!"
